solution_summary: Novo Nordisk used Azure OpenAI Service, Azure Kubernetes Service, Microsoft Dynamics 365 to modernize operations with Microsoft cloud and AI services. Developing high-quality medicine is a resource-intensive endeavor that requires collaboration across Novo Nordisk. Novo Nordisk aimed to scale a pipeline of drug discovery, development, and data science capabilities with AI and machine learning. Key implementation elements included Azure OpenAI Service generates natural-language responses and task automation for the solution; Azure Kubernetes Service runs containerized application services at scale on Azure; Microsoft Dynamics 365 provides the common business process layer that standardizes operations; Power BI delivers reports and dashboards to business users. The solution also connects with Microsoft Research, helping the new platform fit into existing operations.
